subject: Consolidated weekly invoice lane and PO-ack ID mapping for multi-entity chargebacks
messages:
From: Paula McKenna <paula.mckenna@greenlinehealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: consolidated weekly invoice lane + PO header mapping

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement & AP at Greenline want to consolidate Redwood billing into a single weekly invoice lane rather than daily small invoices. A few constraints from our ERP/treasury team:

- Each invoice line must include: PO number, PO_ACK_ID (our internal match key), legal_entity_code, and GL account (we use "GL:#####").
- PO format must support multiple entity chargebacks. Ideally a single header string like: PO12345|ENT2|GL:22010 so our ERPs can parse into lockbox.
- We need net terms of 60 days (Net60) on the initial pilot — treasury will revisit after 90 days.
- Would like an optional 2% holdback line for disputed items for up to 45 days.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
1) Emit a consolidated weekly invoice (one PDF) with line-level metadata in the CSV/EDI for AP match,
2) Put PO_ACK_ID as a separate machine-readable column,
3) Accept Net60 for the pilot, and
4) Provide a sample invoice and PO template for our ERP team to validate?

Attaching our PO template for reference (greenline_po_template.csv).

Best,
Paula
Paula McKenna
Director, Procurement
Greenline Health

--
Attachment: greenline_po_template.csv (CSV stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Paula McKenna <paula.mckenna@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: AP Team <ap@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated weekly invoice lane + PO header mapping

Hi Paula — thanks for the clear summary and the template. We can absolutely support a consolidated weekly invoice lane; below are a few clarifying items so we build the correct mapping for your ERP: 

1) Legal entities: Your template lists two entity codes (ENT1 and ENT2). Do you want one combined invoice that includes lines from both entities, or separate weekly invoices per legal entity? Our billing system can produce either (single PDF + CSV with entity column, or multiple PDFs grouped into one envelope).

2) PO_ACK_ID: We can include a dedicated machine-readable column called PO_ACK_ID in the CSV/EDI export. Confirm format (numeric only vs alphanumeric).

3) Holdback: We can add an optional holdback line per invoice that sums to the configured percentage. Question: Should that be applied at invoice-level or per-PO line?

4) Net terms: Finance will review Net60 for pilot; standard commercial playbook is Net45. If Net60 is required, we will need a brief billing amendment (DocuSign) to avoid revenue recognition gaps.

I attached a sample invoice output that matches how our CSV/EDI will appear (sample-consolidated-invoice.pdf). If this looks OK to you, I will loop in Billing Ops and Vanessa to propose an exact header schema and timeline.

Thanks,
Irene
Head of Procurement Partnerships, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: sample-consolidated-invoice.pdf (PDF stub)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-01T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated weekly invoice lane + PO header mapping

Hi Paula / Irene — looping in Payment Ops and attaching a recommended spec (redwood-weekly-lane-specs.xlsx). Implementation notes: 

- Header format we recommend: PO_NUMBER|ENTITY_CODE|GL_ACCOUNT (example: PO987654|ENT2|GL:22010). That will map directly into lockbox parsers.
- CSV columns: invoice_id, invoice_date, po_number, po_ack_id, entity_code, gl_account, description, qty, unit_price, line_total, holdback_flag.
- Holdback: implement as a separate line per PO with holdback_flag = true. Holdback percentage configurable; propose 2% for your pilot and holdback aging column for automated release after 45 days if no dispute.
- Invoice cadence: weekly consolidated PDF + machine-readable CSV delivered to SFTP or S3 (your preference). We can also push EDI 810 if that is required.
- Net terms: we can accept Net60 for a 90-day pilot, but Billing Ops requires a signed amendment (DocuSign) and Finance will need to confirm revenue recognition adjustments. We also propose an early-pay discount option: 1.5% if paid within 15 days (optional).

Next steps I propose:
1) Greenline confirms single consolidated file vs per-entity split.
2) We provision an SFTP drop and share sample CSV.
3) Sign the billing amendment (DocuSign).

Happy to stand up a 30-minute call with your AP team next week to walk through the CSV.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Billing Ops
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-weekly-lane-specs.xlsx (Excel stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated weekly invoice lane + PO header mapping

Vanessa / Irene — Finance review notes (copied here for the thread):

- Net60 for pilot: Finance is comfortable with Net60 for an initial 90-day pilot provided we have a signed amendment and a clear aging/AR reporting path. We should attach a short schedule that shows cashflow impact.
- Holdback: operationally easier if applied at PO-line level; holdback release should be automated after 45 days unless a dispute flag is raised by Greenline AP.
- Multiple entities on one invoice: acceptable, but we must ensure invoice-level legal entity is set correctly for tax/1099 and remittance routing. Billing Ops should generate either separate PDF per legal entity or include a clear entity header per block in the consolidated PDF.

I can approve the technical mapping. Irene, please prepare the amendment (DocuSign) and include the clause for Net60 pilot + early-pay discount 1.5%/15. Vanessa, please coordinate with Billing Ops to produce a sample CSV drop to Greenline SFTP by COB Thu.

Thanks,
Jonas
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Paula McKenna <paula.mckenna@greenlinehealth.com>

Cc: AP Team <ap@greenlinehealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated weekly invoice lane + PO header mapping

Irene/Vanessa — thanks for the quick turn. We accept the proposed header format (PO_NUMBER|ENTITY_CODE|GL_ACCOUNT) and the weekly consolidated lane delivered to our SFTP. Confirmations: 

- We prefer one consolidated file that contains both entities (ENT1 + ENT2) with entity_code on each line; Greenline AP will split internally.
- PO_ACK_ID should be alphanumeric (we use alpha prefixes occasionally).
- Holdback at PO-line level with a 2% flag is fine for the pilot.
- Net60 pilot accepted; we will sign the amendment.

Please send the sample CSV and a sample PDF invoice to ap@greenlinehealth.com and share the DocuSign amendment link when ready. After we validate the sample mapping with our ERP team we'll schedule the kickoff call.

Appreciate the help — look forward to the pilot.

Best,
Paula
